newsitem.title: USA: ACNielsen says US Justice Dept drops probe.
newsitem.headline: ACNielsen says US Justice Dept drops probe.

text.p: ACNielsen Corp said on Tuesday the Antitrust Division of the U.S. Department of Justice has terminated its inquiry into whether the company had engaged in possible anticompetitive practices.
The justice department had issued a Civil Investigative Demand to the company in January 1995, requesting documents on its competitive practices, the company said.
Earlier on Tuesday, the company said it resolved a European Commission investigation by signing an undertaking to modify certain contractual practices.
The company said that while it believed the practices were not anticompetitive, it decided to modify them because they had no significant impact on its business.
Additionally, the company said the agreement with the European Commission would not impair its ability to achieve a successful turnaround of its European business.
ACNielsen delivers market research, information and analysis to the consumer products and service industries.
